title: Dukhiya Zainab kisko pukaare
body:
dukhiya zainab kisko pukaare
<<DIVIDER>>
sogaye ghazi dariya kanaare
shaam-e-gharibaan ka tha andhera
chaaro taraf tha zulm ka pehra
dil me gham ne deep jalaye
<<MINI>>
dukhiya zainab kisko pukaare
<<DIVIDER>>
meri nazar me rehgaya manzar
bhai akela lakhou'n ka lashkar
zakhmi jigar ye kisko bataaye
<<MINI>>
dukhiya zainab kisko pukaare
<<DIVIDER>>
pair zameen par na rakhti hai
meri sakina kaise chali hai
dard ye apna kisko bata aye
<<MINI>>
dukhiya zainab kisko pukaare
<<DIVIDER>>
raaho'n ke manzar hain ye nirale
ham hai'n khule sar din ke ujale
baalo'n se apna chehra chhupaye
<<MINI>>
dukhiya zainab kisko pukaare
